Married Catherine Casper; their son François married Marie Anne Casper there in December 1809,
after Jacques had died in 1807. Daughter of Henri Caspar of Stundwiller.
She married Jacques Staebell there on 5 August 1782 and was widowed in 1807.
She died at Stundwiller on 5 March 1816, recorded as aged 60, so she was probably born about 1756.
